# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Tuesday, November 3, 2026

*Tuesday edition, compiled before the market opens. Equity, index, rupee and flow numbers are Monday 2 November closes; gold spot and Brent are the latest prints. IBJA's 3 November AM rate had not been published at 07:13 IST, so the IBJA rows show Monday's PM rate. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a separate company from Muthoot Finance Ltd; Muthoot Finance appears here as a listed gold-loan lender.*

---

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

**1. Muthoot Finance hit a 52-week low, then closed up 4.4% as brokerages split on its Q2**
On Monday Muthoot Finance touched ₹2,305 on the NSE, a fresh 52-week low, then closed at ₹2,514.70, up ₹106.10 (+4.41%). ([NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_02112026.csv), [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/muthoot-finance-rebounds-up-9-from-52-week-low-as-stock-reacts-to-q2-nos-126110200210_1.html)) Equirus upgraded it to Add from Reduce with a ₹2,920 target, citing valuation after the six-month fall, and raised its FY27 credit-cost assumption to 70 bp from 20 bp. Motilal Oswal stayed at Neutral with a ₹2,550 target. ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/muthoot-finance-rebounds-up-9-from-52-week-low-as-stock-reacts-to-q2-nos-126110200210_1.html), [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/neutral-muthoot-finance-target-of-rs-2550-motilal-oswal-14066378.html)) Mint sets the numbers side by side: gold AUM up 43% YoY and NIM 11.93% (+152 bp QoQ), but Stage 3 at ₹7,268 crore vs ₹3,926.5 crore in Q1 and Stage 2 at ₹23,466 crore vs ₹1,876 crore in Q1. FY27 gold-AUM growth guidance went to 25% from 15%, with NIM guidance of 10.5–11%. ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/market/mark-to-market/muthoot-finance-share-price-gold-loan-asset-quality-concerns-11793602247502.html))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Gold lenders are now being valued on growth and on the Stage 2 bucket together, so Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 Stage 2 figure (results due by 14 November) is likely to be read against this one.

**2. The gold collateral rate fell again: AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling is ₹10,709/g today, down ₹195**
AGLOC's maximum loan per gram at 85% LTV is ₹10,709 for 3 November, against ₹10,904 for 31 October–2 November. Its jewellery reference price fell to ₹12,599 from ₹12,828. ([AGLOC](https://www.agloc.org/)) IBJA 999 closed Monday's PM session at ₹13,752.4/g, 1.81% below Friday's PM. ([IBJA](https://ibjarates.com/)) Overnight, spot gold rebounded 2.1% to $3,954.41/oz by 1849 GMT after Friday's one-year low, helped by the fall in oil. ([MarketScreener/Reuters](https://ca.marketscreener.com/news/gold-rebounds-from-one-year-low-as-oil-slides-ahead-of-us-midterms-ce785fd8de8fff24))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** The per-gram ceiling caps fresh disbursement and top-ups for gold lenders including Muthoot Fincorp, so a lower rate means smaller ticket sizes on the same jewellery today.

**3. Oil fell 7.6% on Iran-deal hopes, and the rupee closed flat**
Brent settled at $104.77 on Monday, down 7.6%, and was trading at $104.50 on Tuesday morning. ([NDTV Profit](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/oil-prices-today-november-3-brent-crude-oil-near-104-wti-8-percent-crash-us-iran-peace-hopes-ease-supply-fears-trump-commodity-prices-12274002)) The rupee closed at 94.90 per dollar against 94.95; traders see gains capped around 94.50 because of RBI's large forward book. ([BusinessLine/PTI](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/forex/rupee-ends-little-changed-as-traders-stay-cautious-despite-oil-dollar-drop/article71656235.ece))
> Lower oil eases the inflation pressure behind RBI's October rate hike, a factor in NBFC funding costs.

---

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

- **Tranche I public NCD issue (open 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026).** Bids stood at 2.18 times the ₹200 crore base issue as of 17:00 IST on Monday 2 November: retail 1.96×, HNI 3.06×, non-institutional 1.32×, institutional 0.00×. On Friday the figure was 1.86×. The issue size including the green-shoe option is ₹500 crore. ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/))
- **Scheduled dates.** Allotment on 9 November and BSE listing on 10 November, per the issue schedule. ([Groww](https://groww.in/bonds/ipo/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026))
- **Ratings.** The Tranche I NCDs are rated Crisil AA/Stable and Brickwork AA+/Stable. ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/))
- **Subsidiary.** Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's listed microfinance subsidiary, closed at ₹142.58 on Monday, up 5.71% ([NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_02112026.csv)), and holds its Q2 board meeting on 5 November ([Moneycontrol notices](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/muthootmicrofin/notices/MML06/)).

---

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

Monday 2 November: Sensex rose 1,233.25 points (1.66%) to 75,692.78, its highest close since 7 September ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-2nd-november-2026/article71653748.ece)). Nifty 50 rose 387.70 (1.68%) to 23,440.80. Nifty Financial Services lagged at +0.76% (24,899.05), while Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank rose 1.42% (28,909.90) ([NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_02112026.csv)). Reliance's 11% rally after its results led the day, and Nifty Oil & Gas rose 6% ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/fiis-net-bought-indian-equities-worth-rs-3115-crore-while-diis-net-sold-rs-392-crore-on-nov-2-14066733.html)).

Gold-loan and diversified NBFC stocks bounced back from Friday's sell-off: Shriram Finance +4.88%, IIFL Finance +4.79%, Muthoot Finance +4.41%, Manappuram Finance +3.36%, Bajaj Finance +2.16% ([NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_02112026.csv)). FIIs bought a net ₹3,114.68 crore and DIIs sold a net ₹392.20 crore (provisional), after October's FII outflow of about ₹45,162 crore ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/fiis-net-bought-indian-equities-worth-rs-3115-crore-while-diis-net-sold-rs-392-crore-on-nov-2-14066733.html)). October GST collections rose 23% to ₹2.31 lakh crore (same source).

---

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

- No new RBI notifications since 30 October. Monday's press releases were routine: a G-sec auction, Citizen's Charter status and money-market operations ([RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx), [RBI notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx)).
- SEBI issued three circulars on 2 November: frameworks for depository receipts on REIT and InvIT units, and a cooling-off period for offers for sale by private listed InvITs. None applies to NBFCs ([SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/nov-2026/framework-for-issuance-of-depository-receipts-on-units-of-reits-_105558.html)).
- IBBI: no circulars after 30 October ([IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars)).

More detail on today's Rules page.

---

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

See item 1 for the Muthoot Finance follow-up. Muthoot Microfin holds its Q2 board meeting on 5 November ([Moneycontrol notices](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/muthootmicrofin/notices/MML06/)).

---

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

No significant developments today.

---

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

**TVS Holdings puts ₹484 crore into Home Credit India.** TVS Holdings was allotted 12.55 crore shares of Home Credit India Finance in a rights issue; its stake stays at 74.45%. Home Credit is a middle-layer NBFC with FY26 turnover of ₹2,112.74 crore and PAT of ₹132.24 crore. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/tvs-holdings-allotted-shares-in-home-credit-india-finance-as-part-of-rights-issue/article71657537.ece))

**CCI clears Prosus's stake in Navi.** The Competition Commission approved MIH Payments Holdings (Prosus) buying a stake in Navi Ltd, following Prosus's $100 million investment announced in August. ([ETBFSI/PTI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/cci-clears-prosus-proposal-to-acquire-stake-in-sachin-bansal-led-navi/135443265))

---

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

**Fibe launches UPI.** Digital lender Fibe received NPCI approval as a Third-Party Application Provider and launched UPI on its app, covering bank accounts, RuPay credit cards and credit lines on UPI, including for non-customers. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/finance/fibe-enters-upi-payments-segment-after-npci-grants-tpap-approval-20024772.htm))

---

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

- Muthoot Finance's Stage 2 stood at ₹23,466 crore vs ₹1,876 crore in Q1, and Stage 3 at ₹7,268 crore vs ₹3,926.5 crore ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/market/mark-to-market/muthoot-finance-share-price-gold-loan-asset-quality-concerns-11793602247502.html)). See item 1.

---

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

**Aavas Financiers shareholders approve Manu Yeshpal Singh as MD.** All three postal-ballot resolutions passed on 1 November, including his appointment as Managing Director. ([NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/AAVAS_02112026195205_Voting_Result_and_Scrutinizer_Report.pdf))

---

## 🏭 Sector Deep Dive — Tuesday: Gold loans

**1. Banks' gold book is now bigger than NBFCs'.** Bank gold loans grew 83% year on year to ₹5.77 lakh crore, with nearly ₹3 lakh crore added in 12 months. ([Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/corporate/story/bt-explainer-gold-loans-surge-83-to-rs5-77-lakh-crore-what-happens-if-gold-prices-fall-15-564951-2026-11-01)) NBFC gold loans grew 68.5% to about ₹3.54 lakh crore in July, per RBI data cited by Supra Pacific's CEO. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/gold/indias-gold-loan-market-is-entering-a-new-phase-of-growth/article71646198.ece))

**2. What a 15% fall does.** In Business Today's example, a loan at 65% LTV moves to about 76.5% if gold falls 15% and the balance stays the same. Equirus's Shreepal Doshi said a sharp fall could push up NPAs and credit costs, but does not expect a 20–25% drop from here. ([Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/corporate/story/bt-explainer-gold-loans-surge-83-to-rs5-77-lakh-crore-what-happens-if-gold-prices-fall-15-564951-2026-11-01))

**3. The rules are where the stress shows up.** Since 1 April, LTV is capped at 85% for loans under ₹2.5 lakh, 80% up to ₹5 lakh and 75% above that. Muthoot Finance's MD ties the rise in its overdues to the short-tenure, monthly-EMI products that followed. ([Financial Express](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/news/short-tenure-loans-monthly-emis-drive-up-gold-loan-npas-muthoot-finance-md/4374640/lite/))

**4. The collateral rate.** AGLOC's three tiers for 3 November are ₹10,709, ₹10,079 and ₹9,449 per gram, all down from the 31 October–2 November period. Its jewellery reference price (₹12,599) matches IBJA's 22K PM rate on 2 November (₹12,599.0/g). ([AGLOC](https://www.agloc.org/), [IBJA](https://ibjarates.com/))

**5. Competition and growth guidance.** Muthoot Finance raised its FY27 gold-AUM growth guidance to 25%; Motilal Oswal flags a growth-versus-yields trade-off as AAA and AA+ lenders enter the segment. ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/market/mark-to-market/muthoot-finance-share-price-gold-loan-asset-quality-concerns-11793602247502.html))

> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** As a gold-loan NBFC under the same April 2026 rules, Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 disclosures on LTV by ticket band and Stage 2 by product are the figures most comparable with this week's sector numbers.

---

reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Tuesday, 3 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

No new RBI/SEBI circulars or regulatory changes related to NBFCs were found today.

RBI has published no notification since the 30 October batch. Its 2 November press releases are routine (a GoI dated-securities auction, Citizen's Charter status as on 31 October, money market operations as on 1 November). SEBI issued three circulars on 2 November, all on REITs and InvITs. IBBI has nothing new after 30 October.

### What is in the market that is *not* an NBFC circular

| Item | What it actually is |
|------|---------------------|
| **SEBI, 2 Nov:** frameworks for depository receipts on REIT units and on InvIT units, plus a cooling-off period for offers for sale by private listed InvITs. | Capital-markets circulars for trusts, not for NBFCs or debt issuers. cards.title: Muthoot Finance hit a 52-week low, then closed up 4.4% as brokerages split on its Q2
cards.summary: On Monday Muthoot Finance touched ₹2,305 on the NSE, a fresh 52-week low, then closed at ₹2,514.70, up ₹106.10 (+4.41%). (NSE bhavcopy, Business Standard) Equirus upgraded it to Add from Reduce with a ₹2,920 target, citing valuation after the six-month fall, and raised its FY27 credit-cost assumption to 70 bp from 20 bp.
cards.impact: Gold lenders are now being valued on growth and on the Stage 2 bucket together, so Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 Stage 2 figure (results due by 14 November) is likely to be read against this one.

cards.title: The gold collateral rate fell again: AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling is ₹10,709/g today, down ₹195
cards.summary: AGLOC's maximum loan per gram at 85% LTV is ₹10,709 for 3 November, against ₹10,904 for 31 October–2 November. Its jewellery reference price fell to ₹12,599 from ₹12,828.
cards.impact: The per-gram ceiling caps fresh disbursement and top-ups for gold lenders including Muthoot Fincorp, so a lower rate means smaller ticket sizes on the same jewellery today.

latest_circulars.summary: Reference: SEBI circular HO/(201)2026-DDHS-POD1/I/24467/2026 · 27 Oct 2026 - What it says: - Regulation 9C of the DT Regulations (notified 27 Oct 2025) lets DTs move non-SEBI activities into separate business units (SBUs). - The deadline had already been extended once, to 27 Oct 2026. It now moves out by six months because SEBI's Expert Working Group (set up in June 2026) is reviewing the whole DT framework, SBUs included. - All other provisions of the 25 Nov 2025 circular…
latest_circulars.impact: none directly. The circular applies to debenture trustees, not to issuers such as Muthoot Fincorp.
